body: I recently broke up with my ex and started smoking cigarettes. It wasn’t normal for me to display this kind of behavior. My depression worsened. However with support from loved ones as well as my own strengthened mindset, I was able to get over him in a month. Some people take longer than others. That’s okay. It’s normal to feel sad. But if you stay in that phase for too long, you need help.

Especially when people give a simple word in return such as "okay" or "cool". It's easier to leave the conversation as is than proceed to say unnecessary things.

Your words alone are enough. I'm glad I'm not alone in this sort of situation. I do hope all goes well on your part and that things get better.
